description:
SOLARX – Beyond Earth, Beyond Limits.

SOLARX is a team of passionate minds united by curiosity, creativity, and innovation. We believe that every great discovery begins with a bold question and every challenge is an opportunity to create something extraordinary. By combining technology, scientific thinking, teamwork, and NASA's open-source data, we aim to transform complex challenges into meaningful solutions.
summary:
TERRA-VOICE — Earth Information Jukebox* is an interactive, multi-sensory web application and scientific gamified platform that translates real-time NASA Earth observations and NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) visual frames into dynamic, intuitive acoustic soundscapes. 

Addressing the challenge of making massive, abstract planetary datasets accessible to non-specialists, TERRA-VOICE couples a photorealistic 3D WebGL Earth globe and 2D GIS explorer with a mathematical sonification engine. When a user clicks or searches any coordinate globally, live environmental parameters—including air temperature, solar irradiance, precipitation, vegetation canopy density (NDVI), and soil moisture—are pulled dynamically from NASA APIs (NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, MODIS Terra, MERRA-2) and synthesized in real time into harmonious musical stems and an audible "Earth Pulse."

TERRA-VOICE is vital because it bridges the emotional and cognitive gap in climate communication. By transforming cold numerical spreadsheets into evocative melodies and rhythms, it democratizes planetary science, empowers visually impaired researchers through audio accessibility, and fosters deeper intuitive stewardship of our living planet.
details:
(1) What the Project Does & Technical Mechanics

TERRA-VOICE operates as an *Earth Information Jukebox*, allowing users to listen to the biospheric pulse of any location on Earth. Technically, it functions through a synchronized three-tier pipeline:

* *Visual Frame & Geospatial Architecture:* Built on Three.js (WebGL) and Leaflet GIS, the interface renders a photorealistic 3D Earth using NASA Blue Marble 2K true-color textures, specular ocean reflections, topographic normal relief bump maps, and dynamic atmospheric cloud transparency. Users can toggle seamlessly between multiple NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) visual modes—including NASA Blue Marble, VIIRS Night Lights (Black Marble), and MODIS Sea Surface Temperature (SST) heat anomaly maps.

* *Real-Time NASA Telemetry Integration:* Upon clicking any coordinate or searching a region, the platform connects to live satellite feeds:

* *NASA POWER API (v2.10.3):* Fetches 2-metre air temperature (T2M), all-sky surface shortwave solar irradiance (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN), and 2m wind velocity (WS2M).

* *NASA GPM IMERG:* Streams real-time global precipitation rates (mm/hr).

* *NASA MODIS Terra:* Obtains Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) to assess terrestrial greenness and canopy density.

* *NASA MERRA-2 & SMAP L-Band:* Ingests surface wind vectors and root-zone soil moisture (m³/m³).

* *Mathematical Sonification Engine:* Using the native Web Audio API, raw planetary metrics are converted into acoustic parameters without pre-recorded audio loops:

* Temperature is normalized and quantized to a 9-note C4 Major Pentatonic Scale ($261.6\text{ Hz}$ to $784.0\text{ Hz}$), ensuring warming is audible as rising pitch without dissonance.

* Solar Irradiance controls a $24\text{ dB/oct}$ resonant biquad lowpass filter ($400\text{ Hz}$ to $2200\text{ Hz}$), giving sunlit areas acoustic brightness while night zones sound warm and muffled.

* Wind Speed & Rain govern tempo clocks ($75$ to $130\text{ BPM}$) and percussion velocity, accompanied by a dynamic "Earth Pulse" BPM indicator.

* *Six Planetary Channels & Multi-Modal AI:* Features 6 specialized ecosystem channels (Temperature Intelligence, Ocean Symphony, Forest Harmony, Polar Ice, Atmospheric Waves, and Earth in Transition), an interactive *1990–2026 Time-Travel Climate Slider, a **Dual-Region DJ Crossfader*, and computer vision AI modules that convert uploaded satellite photos and environmental video feeds into ambient sound profiles.

(2) Key Benefits*

* *Universal Accessibility:* Enables blind and visually impaired students, educators, and scientists to explore spatial and temporal climate trends through high-fidelity audio cues.

* *Intuitive Pattern Recognition:* The human ear detects micro-rhythms and harmonic shifts faster than visual inspection of complex multi-variable tables.

* *Zero-Friction Engagement:* Launches directly into Mission Control via a cinematic WebGL entrance with no sign-in or authentication barriers.

* *Low-Bandwidth Multi-Tier Resilience:* Built with automated fallbacks (serverless proxy $\to$ direct CORS client fetching $\to$ local geophysical baseline models) guaranteeing smooth 60 FPS operation even in low-connectivity classrooms.

(3) Intended Impact*

TERRA-VOICE is designed for *STEM classrooms, science museums, planetarium installations, and public climate advocacy*. By transforming passive satellite data into an interactive jukebox experience, it inspires students and the public to emotionally connect with Earth’s vital signs, turning climate anxiety into proactive scientific curiosity and planetary stewardship.

(4) Tools, Languages & Technologies Used*

* *Frontend & UI/UX:* HTML5, CSS3 Glassmorphism, Vanilla ES6 JavaScript Modules, Tailwind CSS, JetBrains Mono & Space Grotesk typography.

* *3D Graphics & Mapping:* Three.js (WebGL 3D Earth, custom shaders, specular and normal mapping), Leaflet GIS (2D mapping, administrative geo-boundaries).

* *Audio Engineering:* Web Audio API (polyphonic oscillators, BiquadFilterNode, ConvolverNode space reverb, GainNode envelope shaping, Canvas spectrum visualizer).

* *APIs & Data:* NASA POWER API, NASA GPM IMERG, NASA MODIS Terra, NASA EONET v3, OpenStreetMap Nominatim Geocoding.

* *Backend & Serverless Infrastructure:* Python 3.11 (Flask/HTTP multi-tier proxy), Vercel Serverless Edge Functions (vercel.json), Cloudflare Tunnel.

* *Deployment & Version Control:* Vercel Global Edge Network, Git, GitHub
